name: Olecranon Bursitis
definition: Inflammation or swelling of the olecranon bursa, caused by pressure/trauma, crystal disease, inflammatory disease or infection.

redFlags.item: Fever, marked erythema or systemic illness suggesting septic bursitis
Open wound or rapidly spreading cellulitis

investigations.principle: Most cases are clinical; aspiration is considered if infection/crystal disease is suspected.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs if trauma or bony disease is suspected.

amber: Suspected infection requires aspiration/culture and antibiotics; repeated aspiration/injection carries risk.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-shotha phenotype may be documented after septic causes are excluded.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammation or swelling of the olecranon bursa, caused by pressure/trauma, crystal disease, inflammatory disease or infection.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
